text: Every tribe cooks one dish the way only it does, and eating it carries that tribe's [boon](tribe_boons) for **5 minutes**. Cook them at the [Hearth Pot](hearth_pot).
- **Keeper's Root Mash** (Soil): Emberroot ×2, Steppe Grain, a bowl.
- **Rootbinder Rice** (Sprout): Fen Rice ×2, Spirit Reed, a bowl.
- **Drumheart Chili** (Spark): Emberroot ×2, Glimmer Bean, Raw Game, a bowl.
pages.title: Nine tribes, nine dishes

text: - **Pattern Tart** (Clock): Glimmer Bean, Steppe Grain, Frostberry.
- **Seal-carver's Broth** (Sigil): Fen Rice, Echo Bloom, March Leaf, a bowl.
- **Loom Thread Noodles** (Spindle): Fen Rice ×2, Ley Thistle, a bowl.

Once a tribe calls you **Friend**, its Kin will sell you the dish for four of the crop it is built on. Offer a tribe its own dish at its hearth and it counts for **6 standing**, more than any other gift but a reagent.
